title: Scania R620 FUPS Road Train Custom Bullbar #23
description: Scania R620 high tensile aluminium FUPS approved Road Train Bullbar. The large opening in the lower bar allows the AEB (Advanced Emergency Brake) and the ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) to operate without any interference from the cab protection awarded by the Bullbar. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs, Poly-carb in front of headlights and main channel driving lights. Full width centre section light bar mount. Combination indicator repeater/daylight running lights are recessed in the outer box uprights. Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate.
